asr.full_text: Hey guys and welcome back. This is Miles from Swiss Crypto Podcast and in this episode I'm. Going to talk about one of the biggest Swiss banks there is and it stands on crypto. So. Stay tuned and let's get into it. So this episode is based on a report that I found. Written by UBS, one of the biggest banks in Switzerland itself and also one of the biggest. Banks around the world and why i want to talk about this paper or publication specifically. Even though the article is from april 2019 is because it gives us a good sight into the mind. Or the mindset of ubs the bank and it stands on crypto what we've heard in the last few months. And what I felt was the main vibe in the cryptocurrency space was that big institutions. And also banks are coming into the cryptocurrency space more and more especially with BACT that has. Been launched on 23rd of September and a lot of other banks making their interest in cryptocurrency. Public. But this article from UBS, and that's especially why I picked it, even though it's a. Bit older, isn't that positive on cryptocurrency or Bitcoin. I think we also have to have a look. At articles like these, even though I do believe that we have to look forward into the future,. Look at the positive things that are being done for the cryptocurrency space and all the integration. That happens into the economy but we also shouldn't forget about some of the more negative. Aspects especially from big players like UBS bank is so I'm gonna read to you some of the paragraphs. That they wrote about Bitcoin and what they really thought about Bitcoin back in April 2019. And that really is what I believe to be their stance on crypto. So let's dive right into it. With the first paragraph. Financial media and crypto market commentators have been busy. Publishing articles that in our view fit the narrative to the price by trying to explain the. Sudden bitcoin surge in terms of institutional buying, pension fund allocations, central bank. Stockpiling or some other non-provable reasons. But has anything in the world of cryptocurrencies. Really changed other than the price? We don't think so. As we wrote in Cryptocurrencies Beneath. The bubble in 2017 currencies themselves have no natural value currencies only have value when they. Can buy things that are useful and the two most important and largest classes of economic. Transactions and therefore most useful are labor and taxes in our view until labor and governments. Are willing to adopt cryptocurrencies as payment we do not think they satisfy the first requirement. Of a cryptocurrency. Cryptocurrency transaction processing still seems too slow and too expensive,. Especially given the volatility of many coins. So let's have a look at that last few paragraphs. UBS says that they really don't think that cryptocurrencies in total are good currencies. Because currencies only have value when they can buy things that are useful. I don't really think that this is the case with cryptocurrencies. There are a lot of cryptocurrencies around there, about 2,500 or even more. A lot of them are currently being used for buying useful stuff. Bitcoin or Ethereum or Litecoin or Dash in Venezuela, etc, etc. So I can't really take that argument seriously that cryptocurrencies aren't buying anything useful. So that's for the first argument. The second one is that they say that until labor and governments are willing to adopt cryptocurrencies as payment, they don't think that they satisfy the requirement of currency. Yes and no. I mean, cryptocurrency has to go a few more steps until it's fully adopted into the economy that we have right now. We are still in the early stages, but there are a lot of cryptocurrencies taking those steps with regulators, with banks, with big institutions looking at backed right now. So I think that argument is half true, if you want to say so. I'm pretty sure that this argument will be proven wrong in the future when cryptocurrency. Gets more and more adopted into the everyday economy. And to also talk about the part where they talk about that they don't take cryptocurrency. Seriously until labor and taxes can be done with them. That argument is not valid in my opinion. There are a lot of countries where paying your taxes is possible with cryptocurrencies. I'll take Switzerland as an example here. Some cities, some cantons, parts of Switzerland have made it possible to pay your taxes in. Cryptocurrencies. Moving on to the next paragraph. We similarly believe that cryptocurrencies aren't viable stores of value. Arguments often hinge in the notion that since most cryptocurrencies have a finite supply,. Their value cannot be debased over time by central monetary authorities. This may be true,. But it ignores the fact that while the supply of any individual cryptocurrency is finite,. There is an infinite supply of cryptocurrencies. The volume of initial coin offerings. Reached 22.5 billion in 2018 or three times the cumulative life to date issuance of all ICOs. With unlimited supply, is it any surprise that Bitcoin's price and even its value relative to. Other cryptocurrencies has been volatile? So our bottom line view on cryptocurrencies is unchanged. We do not view cryptocurrencies as currencies. Simply put, Bitcoin and its kin are not mediums. Of exchange and are not stores of values. End of paragraph. So some heavy arguments here. With some heavy final decisions of them by saying that Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies are not a. Medium of exchange for them and not a store of value. Let's take that first argument. Cryptocurrency. Can't be a store of value. I don't think that it's true either. Bitcoin has developed itself. In the past few years to become one of the best stores of value around here, in my opinion,. Because it's adoption and it's security. With the blockchain, with the proof of work algorithm,. There's a lot of security that makes the investment secure and interesting for investors. That want to store value. Also if you look at the stock to flow ratio of Bitcoin you will see that. By the next Bitcoin halving the stock to flow ratio of Bitcoin will be about the same not exactly but. About the same as the one of gold. So Bitcoin is moving more and more into the direction of being. A very good medium for storing value in it. One of the counter arguments that UBS is giving here. In this article is that the fact is ignored that while the supply of any individual currency is. Finite there is an infinite supply of cryptocurrencies i don't take this as a. Serious argument because if you are in the cryptocurrency space and if you would have. Looked at the cryptocurrency space in the last few years you would know that only the good projects. The solid projects survive in cryptocurrency i don't think that we need 2500 cryptocurrencies. Currencies, of course, I don't think all of them will survive. I don't want that. Only the fittest will survive. And with Bitcoin being the very first one. And being one of the biggest ones with the best adoption and as I said,. A very good stock to flow ratio, we don't have that problem with Bitcoin. So I don't take that argument very seriously. If you want to have a look at the article yourself, please feel free. It's down in the description. Please read it. It's only a page long and make up your mind. Give me your opinions on the article itself. I've not included everything out of the article, just so you know. I just wanted to highlight the main arguments that UBS brings up. Or that the guy that wrote it from UBS brings up. Against cryptocurrencies and wanted to talk about why those arguments aren't that serious or aren't. That valuable when it comes to cryptocurrencies or when it comes to arguments against. Cryptocurrencies. If you have another opinion than what I've just talked about, please write it down. Below in the comments. I'm very interested in that. Tell me where you see cryptocurrencies in. The future and if we will see a turn in the interest or behavior of UBS in the future when. It comes to cryptocurrencies I think that will be very interesting. So that's been it for this. Episode I hope you enjoyed the content I provided if you liked the content then please subscribe to. The channel that would mean a lot to me and I'll see you in the next one.
